capabilities: detect calendar events in note text with NLP
synchronize detected events with Apple Calendar or Google Calendar
embed two-way-synchronized inline event views in notes
ban false-positive patterns or define custom event delimiters
log in to calendar providers from the plugin
disambiguation: Not a calendar viewer plugin; its core job is extracting events from note text and syncing them to external calendars.
extras: Google integration was pending review by the Google Trust & Safety team at the time of writing. Apple credentials are stored locally AES-encrypted because Apple lacks OAuth support. The plugin mentions legacy name iCalSync in the How it works section.
problem: Obsidian has no calendar integration, so events written in notes must be manually copied into an external calendar app.

relations.evidence: the supported calendars are: - Apple Calendar - Google Calendar
Google, on the other hand, supports OAuth2 authentication
The plugin works on top of a NLP library (NLP wink)
The communication with iCloud wouldn't be possible without the help of iCloud.js

summary: NLP-based plugin that detects calendar events written in Markdown notes and synchronizes them with Apple Calendar or Google Calendar.
